content.short: Puffer Finance is a native liquid restaking protocol on Ethereum that lowers the barriers for all node operators.
content.description: Puffer Finance is a premier native liquid restaking protocol (nLRP) built on the foundational layer of EigenLayer, designed to decentralize and secure the Ethereum network. By allowing participants to become validators with significantly less ETH than the standard requirement, the protocol fosters a more inclusive and resilient validator set. Users who stake ETH receive pufETH, a liquid token that earns staking rewards and additional yields from Actively Validated Services. Utilizing its SecureSigner technology, Puffer protects node operators from common slashing penalties.
content.meta: Puffer Finance provides native liquid restaking and secure validator infrastructure. Discover Puffer Finance and more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
